function.name: tool_search
function.description: Load the schema of a deferred tool so you can call it. Deferred tools are listed BY NAME ONLY in the system prompt (the 'Deferred tools' section) — their full descriptions and parameters are not in your context until you load them here. Query forms: `select:name,name` loads exactly those names; any other text is keywords matched against tool names and descriptions (up to 8 best matches). Every match is returned in full and becomes callable from your next turn on. Do not guess a deferred tool's parameters; load it first.

query.description: `select:mcp__litesuite-tools__tasks` for exact names, or keywords such as `kanban task board` or `screenshot`
